mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the formation of beat associations for the purpose of protecting mutual interests."
Cartel journalism is the formation of beat associations for the purpose of protecting mutual interests.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is any event, issue or development which in the judgement of the working press, deserves to be brought to the attention and knowledge of the media audience."
The public interest is any event, issue or development which in the judgement of the working press, deserves to be brought to the attention and knowledge of the media audience.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means that they are checked to some extent by laws and ethics."
Regulation means that they are checked to some extent by laws and ethics.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the unethical practice of lifting information (news, statistics, ideas, passages, etc.) from existing materials and presenting it as if it originated from the writer."
Plagiarism is the unethical practice of lifting information (news, statistics, ideas, passages, etc.) from existing materials and presenting it as if it originated from the writer..
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the only institution outside the three arms of government that is so recognized by the Constitution."
The media are the only institution outside the three arms of government that is so recognized by the Constitution.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the same thing as praise singing."
Sycophancy is the same thing as praise singing.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the right which the law gives an author or other originator of an intellectual production whereby he is invested with the sole and exclusive privilege of reproducing and selling copies of his work."

Copyright is the right which the law gives an author or other originator of an intellectual production whereby he is invested with the sole and exclusive privilege of reproducing and selling copies of his work.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is considered as good if it produces good results."
An action is considered as good if it produces good results.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the laws of nature, such as the laws of the natural sciences."
Natural Laws are the laws of nature, such as the laws of the natural sciences.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means that a medium must be concerned with the welfare of its audience and gain them goodwill and patronage."
Journalistic responsibility means that a medium must be concerned with the welfare of its audience and gain them goodwill and patronage.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ can be defined as the correct application of knowledge."
Wisdom can be defined as the correct application of knowledge.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the virtue which considers a person's "deservingness"."
Justice is the virtue which considers a person's "deservingness".
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means that the statement was communicated to a third party, other than the plaintiff."
Publication means that the statement was communicated to a third party, other than the plaintiff.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the third subgroup under the teleological school."
Ethical Pragmatism is the third subgroup under the teleological school.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means a benefit or immunity enjoyed by someone or a class of people which does not apply to the general public."
Privilege means a benefit or immunity enjoyed by someone or a class of people which does not apply to the general public.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the state of being objective."
Objectivity is the state of being objective.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a philosophical concept which has been defined in many ways."
Truth is a philosophical concept which has been defined in many ways.
fib: ______ is the one who has respect for and tries to live by the cardinal virtues which Plato prescribes in The Republic (Merrill, ibid).
virtuous journalist
A virtuous journalist is the one who has respect for and tries to live by the cardinal virtues which Plato prescribes in The Republic (Merrill, ibid).
______ is a lie, for all practical purposes.
half-truth
A half-truth is a lie, for all practical purposes.
______ means that knowledge is obtained through a rigorous observation of events or phenomena, from an external objective reality.
Objectivity to the scientist
Objectivity to the scientist means that knowledge is obtained through a rigorous observation of events or phenomena, from an external objective reality.
______ are those imposed by human authorities for the regulation of human activities.
Man-made laws
Man-made laws are those imposed by human authorities for the regulation of human activities.
______ means being in a state of wholeness, uprightness, honesty or purity.
Integrity
Integrity means being in a state of wholeness, uprightness, honesty or purity.
______ is the person who holds an office in trust for the public and earns his/her living from the taxes paid by the public.
Public official
A Public officer or Public official is the person who holds an office in trust for the public and earns his/her living from the taxes paid by the public.
______ means freedom from all obligations that might interfere with the fidelity to the public interest.
Independence in journalism
Independence in journalism means freedom from all obligations that might interfere with the fidelity to the public interest.
______ is the first article of the 1998 Code of the Ethics for Nigerian Journalists.
Editorial independence
Editorial independence is the first article of the 1998 Code of the Ethics for Nigerian Journalists.
______ is responsible for his ethical response.
individual's ethical orientation
An individual's ethical orientation is responsible for his ethical response.
______ is any action or word which tends to intimidate or obstruct members of parliament from performing their lawful duties.
Contempt of parliament
Contempt of parliament is any action or word which tends to intimidate or obstruct members of parliament from performing their lawful duties.
______ is the illegal reprinting or reproduction of another person's work which is under copyright.
Piracy
Piracy is the illegal reprinting or reproduction of another person's work which is under copyright.
______ are those which only seek to protect the fundamental rights of individuals and ensure the maintenance of peace and tranquillity.
genuinely democratic countries
genuinely democratic countries are those which only seek to protect the fundamental rights of individuals and ensure the maintenance of peace and tranquillity.
______ are the fundamental principles on which journalism practice is built.
Canons of Journalism
Canons of Journalism are the fundamental principles on which journalism practice is built.
______ are the set of rules established by nature or by human authorities, to regulate natural phenomena or human behaviour within a given community or country.
Laws
Laws are the set of rules established by nature or by human authorities, to regulate natural phenomena or human behaviour within a given community or country.

Defamation
